title: Free-Look Cancellation Clause, Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans
content:
**Clause.** Under the Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans, a full refund is given only if the cancellation is requested no later than 10 days after enrollment and no service has been redeemed. The free look is counted in calendar days from the enrollment date, that date being day 0; a request on the last day is in time. The enrollment fee is refunded on a free-look cancellation where the plan's enrollment fee is refundable.

| Plan | Free-look period | Enrollment fee refunded on a free-look cancellation |
|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 10 calendar days | Yes |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | 10 calendar days | Yes |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 10 calendar days | Yes |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 10 calendar days | Yes |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 10 calendar days | Yes |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 10 calendar days | Yes |

**Evidence.** The enrollment date is the one shown on the plan record in the clinic's system, for the plan being cancelled; the comparison is between that date and the date on which the cancellation is requested.

**Effect.** On a free-look cancellation each plan fee charged is refunded in full, each charge by its own refund, and the refunds reduce the plan fees paid in the term. The enrollment fee is refunded as well where it is refundable, which it is under all six plans.

## Both conditions together

| Requested no later than day 10 | No service redeemed | Full refund |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No — a service has been redeemed | No |
| No — requested on day 11 or later | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

## Day count — hypothetical enrollment on 3 March

| Cancellation requested on | Day number | Within the free look? |
|---|---|---|
| 3 March | day 0 | Yes |
| 12 March | day 9 | Yes |
| 13 March | day 10, the last day | Yes |
| 14 March | day 11 | No |

A hypothetical customer who enrolled a kitten on 3 March, requested cancellation on 13 March and has no service redeemed on the plan receives the full refund, enrollment fee included. Had one wellness exam been redeemed on 8 March, the same request would not receive the full refund.
